worktree.setup:
set -e
cd "$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH"
if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" .env; else echo "worktree setup: $PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env missing, skipped" >&2; fi
direnv allow .
for d in */service; do
  if [ -f "$d/package-lock.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund); fi
done
